name: Macrosphenidae
description: Crombecs and African warblers are a diverse family of small passerine birds endemic to sub-Saharan Africa. They vary greatly in size and bill shape, reflecting their varied insectivorous foraging strategies.

children.name: Macrosphenus
children.description: A genus of long-billed warblers found in the forests of Africa.

children.name: Macrosphenus concolor
children.description: The grey longbill (Macrosphenus concolor) is a species of Old World warbler in the family Macrosphenidae.

children.name: Macrosphenus fischeri
children.description: Macrosphenus fischeri (Fischer) is a crombecs species found in Africa region.

children.name: Macrosphenus flavicans
children.description: The yellow longbill (Macrosphenus flavicans) is a species of Old World warbler in the family Macrosphenidae. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist montane forests.

children.name: Macrosphenus flaviventris
children.description: A longbill with yellow underparts from West and Central Africa.

children.name: Macrosphenus kempi
children.description: Kemp's longbill (Macrosphenus kempi) is a species of Old World warbler in the family Macrosphenidae. It is found in Cameroon, Ivory Coast, Ghana, Guinea, Liberia, Nigeria, and Sierra Leone. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

children.name: Macrosphenus kretschmeri
children.description: Kretschmer's longbill (Macrosphenus kretschmeri) is a species of Old World warbler in the family Macrosphenidae. It is found in Kenya, Mozambique, and Tanzania. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist montane forests.

children.name: Macrosphenus pulcher
children.description: A yellow longbill found in the highlands of East Africa.

children.name: Macrosphenus pulitzeri
children.description:
Pulitzer's longbill (Macrosphenus pulitzeri) is a species of bird. Formerly considered an "Old World warbler" and placed in the family Sylviidae, it is now considered to belong to a group of enigmatic African warblers in the family Macrosphenidae. It is found only in Angola.
Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical dry forests. It is threatened by habitat loss.

children.name: Melocichla
children.description: A monotypic genus of large grass warbler with a distinctive black moustachial stripe.

children.name: Melocichla mentalis
children.description:
The moustached grass warbler (Melocichla mentalis) is a species of African warbler, formerly placed in the family Sylviidae.
It is widely found throughout Sub-Saharan Africa, although absent in southern parts of the continent. Its natural habitats are moist savanna and subtropical or tropical moist shrubland.

children.name: Sphenoeacus
children.description: A monotypic genus of large grass warbler endemic to southern Africa.

children.name: Sphenoeacus afer
children.description: The Cape grassbird or Cape grass warbler (Sphenoeacus afer) is an African warbler found in southern Africa.

children.name: Sylvietta
children.description: A genus of small, short-tailed warblers with long curved bills, found in woodlands across sub-Saharan Africa.

children.name: Sylvietta ruficapilla
children.description: The red-capped crombec (Sylvietta ruficapilla) is a species of African warbler, formerly placed in the family Sylviidae.

children.name: Sylvietta rufescens
children.description:
The long-billed crombec or Cape crombec (Sylvietta rufescens) is an African warbler.
The long-billed crombec breeds in southern Africa from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Zambia and Tanzania southwards to South Africa.

children.name: Sylvietta brachyura
children.description: The northern crombec (Sylvietta brachyura) is a species of African warbler, formerly placed in the family Sylviidae.

children.name: Sylvietta dentata
children.description: A crombec with lemon belly from southern Africa.

children.name: Sylvietta virens
children.description: The green crombec (Sylvietta virens) is a species of African warbler, formerly placed in the family Sylviidae.

children.name: Sylvietta isabellina
children.description: The Somali crombec (Sylvietta isabellina) is a species of African warbler, formerly placed in the family Sylviidae.

children.name: Sylvietta leucoptera
children.description: A crombec with white eyebrow from Central Africa.

children.name: Sylvietta philippae
children.description: Philippa's crombec (Sylvietta philippae), also known as the short-billed crombec, is a species of African warbler, formerly placed in the family Sylviidae. It is found in Ethiopia and Somalia. Its natural habitat is dry savanna.
